items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: He was a big fan of mine, well we were fans of each other.

ctx.x: He was a big fan of mine, well we were fans of each other. And when I played and I used to play at the Trident, in Sausalito, he and his wife would come over. As a matter of fact
he’s invited me to his house, I’ve been to, when he was in the penthouse, I remember I walked in one night and he put on some old tunes. I said “Monk, is that you?” He says, “Boy, I’m a kid.”
